scope: Exploratory inspection of 20 selected model-output rows from the five corrected fine-tuned in-domain evaluations. These cases illustrate mechanisms and do not estimate population error rates.
selection: Four rows per model selected from task-specific low-score lists to cover lexical disagreement, low entailment, and verification-target mismatch or a substantive task error. Rows can share underlying seed concepts.
